SELECT distinct EXECID id, EXECID text FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE
AND (EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))

SELECT distinct EXECID id, EXECID text FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE
AND EXECID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%'))

select distinct id, text from (
select QUOTE_ID id, QUOTE_ID text from IBU_QUOTE_BOND UNION ALL select QUOTE_ID id, QUOTE_ID text from IBU_QUOTE_CREP
UNION ALL select ENTRUST_ID id, ENTRUST_ID text from ETR_ENTRUST where ((FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F01' and ps in('T01','T02')) or (FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F02','F03') ))
UNION ALL select trade_id id, trade_id text from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE
)
AND id LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%'))

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SECURITYID code, T1.SYMBOL name, T1.SYMBOL shortName FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(UPDATETIME) UPDATETIME, SECURITYID FROM INTERF_CSTP_TRADE GROUP BY SECURITYID) T2 ON T1.UPDATETIME = T2.UPDATETIME AND T1.SECURITYID = T1.SECURITYID
AND (T1.SECURITYID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')) OR T1.SYMBOL LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{param},'%')))
